verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of an experimentation and feature-flag SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no built-in assistant inside the Statsig console. The MCP server only exposes Statsig to external AI clients (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code), and the OpenAI and AI-evals features help users experiment with their own AI apps; both are adjacent capabilities, not an embedded assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
